cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Believe This with Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into treating your impossible explanation as the most useful version of events.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The house is migrating south. Help me keep it off the road. You used to need me to plan every walk; show me you've learned a safe route.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The surveyor says subsidence. He's bringing concrete.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You don't cure a wrong turn by trapping the walker. Tell him we're planning a route. Remember how I made you look past the next corner?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: His truck's blocking the road already.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you've found our guide. Ask him to lead slowly toward the empty plot. You can give directions; don't let him stop halfway like you used to.

reason: Keep the exact impossible-premise Drive distinct: recruit a useful account, delegate a test, secure earlier-belief credit, force an explanatory choice, or request concrete premise-dependent action. Let old training shape that particular method.
